---
description: Write where a table's, column's, report's or output column's values come from, as a DBML slice.
title: ichnos upstream
---

`ichnos upstream` writes where the values of a table, a column, a report or an output column come from, as a DBML slice.
It starts at exactly one of `--table` and `--report`, and `--column` moves the start to a column of the table or to an output column of the report.
`--indirect first_hop` keeps the indirect dependencies of the queries that write the start, and `all` keeps every one.

## Usage

```{python}
#| label: help
#| echo: false
from _scripts.example import ichnos

ichnos("upstream", "--help")
```

## Example

The core of this slice exceeds the budget, so ichnos writes it whole and says so on stderr.

```{python}
#| label: example
#| echo: false
from _scripts.example import ichnos

ichnos("upstream", "queries", "--report", "055_key_customers", "--budget", "2500")
```
